name: romanesco
description: The Romanesco typeface is a refined, semi-bold and narrow hand crafted calligraphic style. With stabbing strokes that nod to historical styles, and modern flair leaning towards the current, Romanesco lends itself to a wide array of stylistic uses for a narrow typestyle.
